title: HuskyLens LEGO tray (first draft)
sub: One print. The board drops in screen up, camera through the back, and two M3 screws through its tab hold it. Pin holes in the two columns and the bar under the tab.
axes: across, left to right as you look at the screen; 0 the centre line
up the board; the tab and both cables at −y, the buttons at +y
front to back; 0 the tray's back face (the bed), the screen faces +z

items.label: Tray
items.note: Columns 5 × 1 holes each, bar 3 × 2 under the tab, floor with the camera notch

items.label: Board, screen, camera
items.note: 52 × 44.5 with the tab; screen up, camera down

items.label: Buttons and sockets
items.note: Dial and learn button on top, USB and UART out of the bottom, SD on the right

items.label: M3 screws
items.note: 2 × M3 × 8 through the tab into heat-set inserts (or bolts and nuts)
